text.formatted: Starting at 14th level, if you are able to hear, you are aware of the location of any hidden or Invisible creature within 10 feet of you.
text.plain: Starting at 14th level, if you are able to hear, you are aware of the location of any hidden or Invisible creature within 10 feet of you.

gaps.name: If you can hear, you know the location of any hidden or invisible creature within 10 feet, without necessarily seeing it.
